title: 同步拉取只按项目范围过滤，未实施实体查看权限
head: 138cf2da1b63195cef7e884f69bdf8ded6ed3c21
preconditions: Authenticated user can see a project
User lacks the corresponding entity view permission
The entity row is within the since window

source.symbol: sync init query loop and ACL response

evidence.limitation: Historical isolated route probe: online task detail 403 but sync init 200 included task; no rerun.
Current pull loop does not use entity permission metadata; same-project permission revocation cache handling is source-confirmed but not dynamically exercised.

counterevidenceChecked: ACL response contains permission codes but query loop does not use them.
observedImpact: Historical actor lacking entity view permissions read a task through sync although online detail was denied.
potentialImpact: After a same-project entity permission is revoked, init can continue returning data and client ACL cleanup only purges projects no longer visible.
recommendation: Define per-entity read policy and filter every pull by effective system/project capabilities; invalidate cached entity families when those grants are revoked.
acceptanceCriteria: Any entity denied by equivalent online read authorization is absent from sync response.
Revoking one entity permission in a still-visible project removes its cached rows and prevents future pulls.
Own-only reports remain restricted to their author.

title: 同步拉取受硬上限截断后仍推进时间游标
head: 138cf2da1b63195cef7e884f69bdf8ded6ed3c21
preconditions: More than 3000 matching upserts or 5000 tombstones exist for a pull
Client accepts response cursor and next request starts after it

source.symbol: bounded entity queries and serverTime cursor

callPath: query each entity with gt since and take limit
unreturned rows fall behind next since

evidence.limitation: Historical isolated DB probe had 3001 qualifying tasks, returned 3000 then 0 next pull; not rerun.
The query/cursor window is confirmed statically; other commit-interleaving and tombstone-cap scenarios were not run.

counterevidenceChecked: Rows are ordered ascending by timestamp.
Project and soft-delete scopes are applied.
There is no stable ID tie-breaker, continuation token, or cap-completion signal.
observedImpact: Historical probe permanently omitted at least one qualifying task after advancing cursor beyond the capped result.
potentialImpact: Tombstone truncation, equal timestamps, and writes committed across read/cursor windows may also omit changes; these cases were not separately demonstrated.
recommendation: Use a fixed upper boundary, stable composite keyset pagination for each entity and tombstone stream, and advance the checkpoint only after every stream reaches that boundary.
acceptanceCriteria: More than 3000 upserts and 5000 tombstones are fully paged before checkpoint commit.
Equal timestamp rows are neither skipped nor duplicated.
A concurrent write is returned in this or the following pull, never behind an already committed cursor.
pendingQuestions: Choose/verify a database-consistent snapshot boundary or a change log whose visibility ordering handles late commits.

title: 新授权项目只更新同步 ACL，没有触发历史数据回填
head: 138cf2da1b63195cef7e884f69bdf8ded6ed3c21
entrypoint: GET /api/sync/init after project membership is added
preconditions: Client has a prior since cursor
Actor becomes a member of a live project with older rows
Rows have timestamps earlier than the old cursor

source.symbol: ProjectMember has joinedAt/leftAt and no updatedAt

callPath: init still queries old rows using client since
client only purges rows for removed project IDs
new project historical state remains absent

evidence.limitation: Historical isolated probe showed ACL included project but project and historical task upserts were empty; not rerun.
Current source supports join/backfill gap; leave/rejoin and membership-role changes were not dynamically probed.

counterevidenceChecked: ACL version hashes visible projects and permissions.
Client reacts to ACL change, but only deletes rows belonging to project IDs no longer visible.
ProjectMember timestampField is joinedAt; schema has no updatedAt/revision.
observedImpact: Historical probe left the newly authorized project and historical task absent from local sync payload despite ACL containing the project.
potentialImpact: ProjectMember role changes may not be represented as a later timestamp event; not separately tested.
recommendation: Represent authorization grants as versioned changes and require a scoped initial snapshot for each newly visible project before accepting its incremental cursor.
acceptanceCriteria: A user with an existing cursor who joins an old project receives its current project and historical rows.
Revoke/leave removes local data before the new ACL version is committed.
Leave/rejoin and role changes produce complete permission-aware refreshes.
